entity_raw.source_book_raw: Pathfinder Campaign Setting: Inner Sea Taverns
entity_raw.definition_raw:
You can gain some insight into the mood of a crowd with just a look.

Prerequisite(s): Drunken Sing-Along, Diplomacy 1 rank, Perform (sing) 1 rank, Sense Motive 1 rank.

Benefit(s): Before you use the Drunken Sing-Along feat, you can attempt a DC 20 Sense Motive check as a free action to pick the exact right song for that crowd.

If you are successful, you gain a +4 circumstance bonus on your next Diplomacy check to gather information in that tavern.
